messages.text: wait. i just pulled the logs from the GX10.
p95 is sitting at 4.2s. that's not right.
huh? my local tests were under a second. am i hitting the same endpoint?
yeah. look at this timestamp gap. 46 seconds to start responding after the first request.
oh god. is it unloading the model?
yep. ollama default behavior when idle. we are paying a 46s tax for every cold start.
that explains the latency spikes. my embeddings were fine but the adjudication calls were lagging.
we need a heartbeat. keep it warm. can you script that?
sure. hit /api/generate with an empty prompt every 2 mins? should keep the weights in vram.
also batch the embeddings. you're sending them one by one, right?
let's batch to 256. and set instruct concurrency to 2. we don't want to thrash the gpu either.
doing it now. give me 10 mins to update the worker config.
